claims.claim_text: Commitment to reduce gasoline prices by acting against speculators who push prices above natural market rates.
Commitment to direct the U.S. Federal Trade Commission and Department of Justice to vigorously investigate and prosecute manipulation of oil futures markets.
Commitment to increase funding for low-income heating assistance and weatherization programs to help people hardest hit by high energy prices.
Commitment to provide energy assistance to middle-class families facing the high energy prices described in 2008.
The comprehensive clean-energy and energy-price plan described in 2008 will protect the U.S. economy, the country and the planet's future.
The comprehensive clean-energy and energy-price plan described in 2008 will create well-paid jobs that cannot be outsourced.

The comprehensive clean-energy and energy-price plan described in 2008 will protect the United States against national-security threats from foreign-oil dependence and climate-related global insecurity.
A comprehensive plan and clean-energy investment will solve the four-dollar-per-gallon gasoline problem described in 2008.
